exposure: Congenital uterine malformation type (septate, sub-septate, unicornuate, bicornuate, didelphic)
cohort: 180 women with congenital uterine malformation who underwent laparoscopy and hysteroscopy
finding: Uterine malformation surgery significantly improved reproductive prognosis in women with CUM, with a significant reduction in spontaneous abortion rate after surgery.
